categories.main_business_segments: Everlight Electronics primarily operates in the optoelectronics sector, focusing on two main product categories: light-emitting components (LEDs) and sensing components. Their LED products include visible light and infrared LEDs, LED lighting sources, fixtures, and light engines, while sensing components cover phototransistors, photodiodes, photo couplers, and optical sensors. The company also provides LED lighting modules and customized LED components, with applications spanning consumer electronics, automotive lighting, industrial control, and display technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced LED packaging technologies including low, middle, and high power LED lamps, SMD (Surface Mount Device) technology, CSP (Chip Scale Package), and Mini/Micro LED technologies. Their production processes involve chip bonding, wire bonding, molding, testing, and assembly, adhering to international standards such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001. They also focus on developing high-efficiency, high-brightness LEDs with specialized packaging for automotive and industrial applications, and invest in R&D for UV LEDs, RGB+IC smart LEDs, and wide bandgap power devices like SiC and GaN.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Everlight serves a diverse customer base including manufacturers of consumer electronics, automotive OEMs, industrial automation companies, and display device producers. Key markets include Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with products used in applications such as mobile phones, LCD backlighting, automotive lighting (headlamps, tail lamps, interior ambient lighting), industrial control systems, and smart city infrastructure. The company also targets emerging markets like wearable devices, UV sterilization, and plant/agriculture lighting.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in Asia (notably Taiwan and China), Europe, and the Americas. It has subsidiaries and sales offices in countries including the United States, Germany, Korea, India, Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Kazakhstan. Manufacturing facilities are located in Taiwan and China, with sales and marketing networks extending worldwide to serve global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Everlight Electronics operates primarily in the midstream segment of the optoelectronics supply chain, focusing on LED packaging, module assembly, and component manufacturing. It sources semiconductor chips (wafers) from upstream suppliers and delivers finished LED components and modules to downstream customers in various industries. The company also engages in some vertical integration through investments in related entities involved in chip supply and display manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D investment in advanced LED technologies, including Mini/Micro LED, UV-C LEDs for sterilization, automotive lighting solutions, and wide bandgap semiconductor power devices (SiC/GaN). It focuses on innovation in packaging, energy efficiency, and smart lighting systems, aiming to expand applications in automotive, industrial automation, AIoT, and green energy sectors. Everlight also prioritizes sustainability, integrating carbon management and energy-saving technologies into its operations and product development.
categories.revenue_model: Everlight generates revenue primarily through the sale of LED components, sensing devices, lighting modules, and customized optoelectronic products. Its income streams include product sales to OEMs and industrial customers globally. The company also earns licensing fees from patent agreements and investments in related businesses, but the core revenue is from product manufacturing and sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Everlight is a leading Taiwanese LED packaging company with strong market positions in lamp, SMD, and infrared sensing components. Major competitors include Nichia, Seoul Semiconductor, Osram, Rohm, and Lumileds in various product segments. The company maintains competitive advantages through extensive patent holdings, diversified product lines, global customer relationships, and continuous R&D, positioning itself as a top-tier global supplier in the LED and optoelectronics industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Everlight reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$20.97 billion, reflecting a 17.5% year-over-year growth. The company achieved a gross margin of 30%, improved by 1% due to better product mix and cost control. Net profit attributable to the parent company doubled to NT$2.94 billion, with earnings per share of NT$6.64. The company has a stable financial base with total assets nearing NT$29.78 billion and equity of about NT$20.77 billion, demonstrating steady growth and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Everlight differentiates itself through high-quality, reliable LED and sensing components with advanced packaging technologies tailored for diverse applications including automotive, industrial, and consumer electronics. The company emphasizes innovation, energy efficiency, and sustainability, offering smart LED solutions and specialized products like UV-C sterilization LEDs and wide bandgap power devices. Its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and global supply chain integration provide customers with comprehensive, cutting-edge optoelectronic solutions.
